Getting started with Northwind Analytics

This guide connects a warehouse to Northwind Analytics and produces a first freshness alert. It takes about ten minutes and needs a read-only warehouse role.

Step 1: create a read-only role

Northwind Analytics reads table metadata only. Create a role with USAGE on the database and SELECT on INFORMATION_SCHEMA, and grant nothing else. Northwind Analytics never reads row data.

Step 2: add the connection

In Northwind Analytics, open Connections, choose Snowflake, BigQuery or Postgres, and paste the host, database and role. The connection test reads one metadata row and reports success or the exact permission that is missing.

Step 3: choose tables to monitor

Northwind Analytics lists every table it can see with its last write time. Select the tables that feed dashboards. Start with ten; you can add more at any time up to your plan limit.

Step 4: set the alert channel

Add a Slack channel or an email address. Northwind Analytics sends the first alert as soon as a monitored table misses its learned completion window, which usually happens within one day.

Troubleshooting

If the connection test fails with a permission error, the role is missing SELECT on INFORMATION_SCHEMA. If tables are missing from the list, the role lacks USAGE on that schema.
